messages:
maria (marketing): Quick sync 1: launch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL, canonical docs links, bench snapshot for the blog, and ops confirmation on canary timing. Also want to A/B two hero CTAs for the blog. Who can own what? :pray:

ryan (eng): Changelog diff is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/compare/v1.9.1...v1.10.0. Small note about model-router fallback added.

zoe (product): I'll review release notes and pick the CTA variants. Suggest we test "Predictable latency at any scale" vs "Lower unit-cost inference for production".

lee (docs): Canonical docs: Getting started: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started, API reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/api, Benchmarks: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026. Added code sample with `model: redwood-std-3` and `quantized: true`.

maria (marketing): Marketing wants median/p95 latency and an approximate cost-per-1k tokens for the post. Can ops/eng paste numbers?

ryan (eng): Latest dedicated-run numbers: median = 46ms/token, p95 = 200ms/token. Estimated cost = $0.0020 per 1k tokens (with current batching). Raw CSV: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-2026-final.csv

jim (ops): Canary plan: start 09:30 PT smoke 5% for 10m, ramp to 40% for 20m at 09:45 PT, full at 10:15 PT. Rollback triggers: error-rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 >650ms for 3 consecutive 60s windows. I'll own watch and post updates here.

maria (marketing): Need a console screenshot for the post by 10:20 PT. Can docs grab it after smoke and redact?

lee (docs): Yep I'll grab the screenshot after smoke and redact internal IDs. Will upload to Confluence and share the link here.

ryan (eng): Deploy commands for reference: ```
helm upgrade --install redwood-inference ./charts/serve --namespace prod --set image.tag=launch-2026-canary
# or: gcloud run deploy serve --image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026-canary
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 1765656600. Image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-2026-canary. Logs: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1765656600

jim (ops): I'll also open a short-lived public snapshot link to grab the screenshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/launch-2026/snapshot-10am (expires +3h).

zoe (product): Webinar CTA routing 1: use SFDC campaign `Q2-Launch-2026`. Mapping to marketing@redwood.ai via webhook. If marketing wants a separate nurture path, say so now.

maria (marketing): Keep on Q2-Launch-2026 but add utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026 on the CTA. For hero CTA pick variant A/B by 5pm today.

lee (docs): Uploaded redacted screenshot: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Docs/attachments/launch-console-snapshot.png. Updated Getting Started to reference the blog post and included the benchmark table.

maria (marketing): Screenshot received, looks good. We'll schedule the blog for 11:00 PT and include changelog + docs + bench table + webinar CTA.

ryan (eng): Heads-up: cold KV cache can add ~120-180ms on first few tokens for long sequences. Ops has warming job but call out as "known behavior" in docs. Also fallback configured to `redwood-lite-3` if p95 > 800ms for 3 windows.

jim (ops): Noted. I'll monitor and escalate if we breach thresholds. Setting deploy-bot automated rollback hook on the canary and a temporary throttle cap at 85% CPU for the pool during first hour.

maria (marketing): Thanks team. Final roll call 09:15 PT in #marketing for any late changes. If anything pops, @maria and post here. Big day! :tada:
